service.description: The organization's invoice layout over a sample invoice of forty lines in its base currency, numbering and footer, rendered by Mantle's invoice print template (the one get#InvoiceOutput renders), so a layout is checked across pages. No number is issued. Refuses a layout that is not offered and a user who may not administer accounting; says what is missing when there is no organization or base currency.
